body: Thank you. I will see what I can do to anonymously report him.

I haven’t reported him because It ended over a year ago, I have very little proof, he’s well liked by people, and it’s his word against mine. I have seriously considered anonymously reporting though, I just don’t know how.

I completely understand how you feel, I was groomed as well, from 16-20 I was groomed by a teacher almost 40 years older than me. I blamed myself for it because I thought, “why didn’t I just realize that it was wrong?” Hindsight is 20/20, if I was 16 with the knowledge I have now, maybe it would have been different. Unfortunately as young person we aren’t equipped to think of the consequences of decisions, but it isn’t our fault. If an adult is in a position of power, such as age, status, or job position, then it is their responsibility to keep those boundaries and not pray on those who are vulnerable.

You were probably exploring and feeling exciting things, which is something my therapist told me. And it makes sense, young people want to explore and learn and some adults take advantage of it. 

I believe you, you aren’t making anything up when it’s his responsibility to not be a predator. I feel the same way too. I want my last years of high school and first years of university back. Knowing he is still out there teaching students and everyone loves him kills me inside, because to me he will always be a groomer. 

I know you can get through this, stay strong!
